lang.option.DEBUG_ENABLE.comment: Renders whatever the show() function is called on to the screen.
lang.option.FREEZE_TIME.comment: Disables all animations built into the shader, like water waves.
lang.option.EXPOSURE.comment: Controls the final brightness of the screen. This setting is ignored if §eauto exposure §fis enabled. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.AUTO_EXPOSURE.comment: Automatically adjusts the exposure based on the brightness of the scene. §aMinimal performance impact.
lang.option.AMBIENT_STRENGTH.comment: The minimum amount of light there can be in any situation. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.OLD_LIGHTING.comment: Enables the vanilla lighting based on the facing direction. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.FLOODFILL.comment: Makes the light emitted by blocks match their colour. Requires §eshadows §fto be enabled. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.EMISSION_STRENGTH.comment: How bright emissives are. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.BLOCKLIGHT_STRENGTH.comment: How bright the light emitted by blocks is. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.ambientOcclusionLevel.comment: Darkens corners where blocks meet to imitate ambient shadowing. §9No performance impact! §falso affects §eDistant Horizons Ambient Occlusion.
lang.option.shadowDistance.comment: The radius around the player in which things can cast shadows. §cHigh performance impact!
lang.option.entityShadowDistanceMul.comment: The fraction of the shadow distance within which entities will cast shadows. Setting to 0 will entirely disable entity shadows. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.shadowMapResolution.comment: The resolution of the shadow map (how pixelated it is). §cHigh performance impact!
lang.option.SHADOW_SAMPLES.comment: The number of shadow samples taken per pixel. Higher values reduce noise. §cHigh performance impact!
lang.option.SHADOW_SOFTNESS.comment: How soft shadows will appear. Higher softness values hide pixelated shadows better at the cost of noise. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.sunPathRotation.comment: The angle of the path the sun and moon follow through the sky. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.DIRECTIONAL_LIGHTMAPS.comment: Attempts to guess which direction block and skylight is coming from. Works best with a resource pack that has normal maps. §2Imperceptible performance impact.
lang.option.DYNAMIC_HANDLIGHT.comment: Illuminates the area around the player when a light source is held. §2Imperceptible performance impact.
lang.option.PBR_MODE.comment: LabPBR requires a supported resource pack. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.BLOCKY_CLOUDS.comment: Makes clouds have clearly defined square shapes in them. This was originally a bug, but people liked it, so now it's a feature! §9No performance impact!
lang.option.ATMOSPHERIC_FOG.comment: Makes terrain fade into the distance. §aMinimal performance impact.
lang.option.CLOUDY_FOG.comment: Adds a mist-like fog sitting over the ground. More obvious in the morning and when it rains. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.BASE_FOG_DENSITY.comment: The density of §efancy fog§f. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.MORNING_FOG_DENSITY.comment: How much the density of §efancy fog§f increases in the morning. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.GODRAYS.comment: Makes objects appear to cast shadows through §efancy fog. §fThe §escreen-space §f is less accurate and will disappear if the sun is not on the screen. The §evolumetric §fmode §frequires §eshadows §fto be enabled, and will look bad at lower §eshadow quality/distance §fsettings. §aminimal performance impact.
lang.option.GODRAYS_SAMPLES.comment: How many samples are taken when rendering godrays. Higher values reduce noise at the cost of performance. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.CLOUD_SHADOWS.comment: Makes clouds cast a shadow. §aMinimal performance impact.
lang.option.BORDER_FOG.comment: Fades terrain into the sky towards the edge of the render distance. §2Imperceptible performance impact.
lang.option.REFLECTION_MODE.comment: Adds reflections to water. The 'fast' option guesses where the reflection might be, and is often innacurate, while SSR traces through the scene to find an intersection point. §cHigh performance impact!
lang.option.ROUGH_SKY_REFLECTIONS.comment: Adds sky reflections to PBR materials. §aMinimal performance impact.
lang.option.SSR_STEPS.comment: Higher values will reduce noise/stepping in water reflections §ewhen SSR is enabled §fat the cost of performance. §6Moderate performance impact. §7Note that each step takes 4 samples.
lang.option.FADE_REFLECTIONS.comment: Fades reflections into the sky as they approach the edge of the screen to prevent the otherwise hard cutoff. §2Imperceptible performance impact.
lang.option.SSR_JITTER.comment: When enabled, §eSSR §freflections will appear noisy, however there will be no 'stair-stepping' effect. §2Imperceptible performance impact.
lang.option.REFRACTION.comment: Bends light as it enters or leaves water. §aMinimal performance impact.
lang.option.WATER_SCATTERING_MOD.comment: Controls how much light scatters in the water, making it appear more foggy. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.WATER_ABSORPTION_MOD.comment: Controls how much light water absorbs, which causes the blue tint on things which are viewed through it. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.CAUSTICS.comment: Emulates how light refracting through water appears to cast a shadow. Requires §eshadows §fto be enabled, and will look bad at lower §eshadow quality §fsettings. §aMinimal performance impact.
lang.option.BLOOM.comment: Makes bright objects appear to glow. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.BLOOM_RADIUS.comment: How far across the screen bloom will spread out. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.BLOOM_STRENGTH.comment: How much effect the bloom has on the final colour of the screen. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.BLOOM_QUALITY.comment: What percentage of the screen resolution to run bloom at. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.TEMPORAL_FILTER.comment: Uses data from previous frames to reduce noise. Can result in blurriness and ghosting. §2Imperceptible performance impact. §7Please don't buy into Threat Interactive's anti TAA campaign. §7He is right that many modern games are using it as a crutch but has no credibility and does not understand graphics programming. §7The real issue is that most studios do not give developers the time necessary to properly optimise their games.
lang.option.FXAA.comment: Anti-aliasing - removes jagged edges. §aMinimal performance impact.
lang.option.WAVING_BLOCKS.comment: Makes plants sway in the breeze. §aMinimal performance impact.
lang.option.PATCHY_LAVA.comment: Adds some variation to the brightness of lava. §2Imperceptible performance impact.
lang.option.INFINITE_OCEAN.comment: Adds an ocean that stretches out to infinity. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.SEA_LEVEL.comment: What altitude the infinite ocean should render at. §9No performance impact! §7If you need a sea level that isn't an option here, let me know!
lang.option.DH_AO.comment: Makes edges of blocks more defined on distant terrain. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.DH_AO_SAMPLES.comment: Higher values will run worse but reduce noise. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.PARALLAX.comment: Makes blocks and entities appear to have depth. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.PARALLAX_HEIGHT.comment: How far into the block a depth of 1.0 should be. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.PARALLAX_DISTANCE.comment: How far away parallax should stop rendering. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.PARALLAX_SAMPLES.comment: How many samples should be taken when computing parallax. Higher values reduce jagged edges but have a performance cost. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.PARALLAX_SHADOW.comment: Allows parallax to cast a shadow. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.PARALLAX_SHADOW_SAMPLES.comment: How many samples should be taken when computing parallax shadows. §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.WATER_PARALLAX.comment: Adds depth to water waves.  §6Moderate performance impact.
lang.option.CAVE_SKY_DARKENING.comment: Makes the sky dark and reduces fog when the game thinks you are underground. §9No performance impact!
lang.option.MOTION_BLUR.comment: Blurs things when the camera moves. This can make the game feel smoother at low framerates. §aMinimal performance impact.
lang.option.BLOCK_OUTLINE.comment: Controls the outline around the currently selected block.When set to §eoff§f, it is invisible. When set to §eon§f, the colour is configured by the sliders below. When set to §erainbow§f, it changes colour over time.
lang.option.tonemap.comment: How the final colour is graded. §2Imperceptible performance impact.
